status: Retrospective follow-up. Fixed locally before computing these new cross-tabulations. Existing nested, separating and random headline results were already known.
population: All 274 frozen nonempty distinct proposals on the existing nested search trajectories. No replacement of unprobeable proposals. The primary matched factorial denominator comprises all proposals with at least one previously unqueried interior mask. Separately condition on passing both ranking endpoints to audit the earlier 14/26 readout. Endpoint-only checks also reported for proposals without an eligible interior.
factorial: For each proposal evaluate empty and full-restoration endpoints vs the archived common novel interiors, on both the original ranking rows/weights and disjoint guard rows/weights. A family fails if any context has at most two of four affirmative ballots. Produce four pass/fail indicators, their complete joint 2x2x2x2 distribution, and paired event counts by split and dataset. The row factor changes sampled individuals AND their bootstrap weight vectors. A failure outside the design refers to these sampled masks only. A failure on novel guard masks with all guard endpoints passing is separately counted.
budget: To match the two distinct endpoints, compute the exact probability of at least one failure in two draws without replacement from the recorded novel interior masks, averaging over all possible pairs within each proposal. Do this on both row panels. Compare against all-interior and endpoints. The per-proposal family budgets match, but cardinalities differ. Also tabulate directional discordances for every pair of novel contexts of equal cardinality, classifying their signs on both row samples and counting candidate-level reproducibility. Pairs reuse contexts and candidates.
outcomes: Describe selection by nested trajectory and endpoint passage; give each dataset's counts, eligible denominators, finite-probe exposure, and missing cells. For each retrospective rule count its ranking veto among guarded failures separately with and without a guard endpoint failure. No inference from proposals, masks, resamples or reused seeds as independent observations. No population detection rates or generalization claims.
verification: Recalculate utility and votes from stored row-level predictions and weights without calling the research pipeline scorer or decision code. Validate hashes, exposure exclusions, mask-index lookup, original partial nested ballots, reserved row separation and outcome agreement with the archived decision summary. Each split uses one process with a 1-hour wall-clock limit.
